title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Marketing Ai Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview: As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our "agentic" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a "Builder" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Core Responsibilities: - Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.
- Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.
- Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to "read" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.
- Performance & Guardrails: Establish "human-in-the-loop" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.
- System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM. Qualifications & Skills: - Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.
- AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.G., Claude CoWork, CodeX) - Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.G., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.Com) or code-based frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI).
- Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex "reasoning loops" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.
- Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.
- Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Ai Agent Manager (Media)
description: About the Product For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Job Purpose The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes. The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities Main Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.G., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks). Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.G., media planning, operations, finance workflows). Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems. Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic. Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users. Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases. Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements. Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability. Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems. Core Requirements 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role. Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic. Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.G., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms). Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms). Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) Technical / AI-Related Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts). Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus. Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required. Soft Skills Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders. Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes. Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches. Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment. Domain Experience Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents. title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

Voz da Família e Melhoria Contínua:Gestão por Indicadores: Monitorar KPIs (NPS, CSAT, tempos de resposta) sempre com o foco na satisfação real de quem assina.Ponte Interna: Traduzir os feedbacks das famílias em sugestões práticas para os times de Produto, Logística e Marketing.O que buscamos em você:Experiência em Liderança: Vivência em gestão de equipes de Customer Experience, preferencialmente em ambientes dinâmicos.Domínio do Zendesk: Experiência prática na configuração da ferramenta (nível administrador).Perfil Analítico e Humano: Capacidade de ler números sem esquecer que eles representam pessoas.Comunicação Impecável: Alinhada com os valores de empatia e clareza do Quindim.Diferenciais que nos encantam:Passagem por modelos de assinatura ou e-commerce.Vivência com integração de APIs ou outras ferramentas de CX.Informações sobre a vaga:Remuneração competitiva, em modalidade PJBonificação por desempenhoPlano de Saúde (após 3 meses de prestação de serviço)Plano Odontológico (após 3 meses de prestação de serviço)Total PassAcademy Sólides (plataforma de curso online)Modelo de trabalho presencial em fase de imersão, com plano de transição para modelo híbrido, conforme metas de estabilização da operação.Day off no aniversárioAcesso ilimitado a livros infantis incríveis!A oportunidade de causar um impacto real na formação de milhares de leitores.Quem SomosO Clube Quindim não é apenas uma empresa — é um movimento que acredita em Diversidade, Empatia, Renovação e Sustentabilidade. Somos apaixonados por levar literatura transformadora para crianças de todo o Brasil, incentivando o prazer da leitura, o pensamento crítico e o fortalecimento de vínculos afetivos.Nossa missão é tornar a leitura uma experiência acessível, encantadora e significativa, ajudando a formar novas gerações mais sensíveis, criativas e conscientes. Acreditamos que cada história pode abrir mundos — e é isso que nos inspira todos os dias.Diversidade e InclusãoNo Clube Quindim, acreditamos que a pluralidade é nossa força. Valorizamos e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIA+, mulheres e mães.

DIFERENCIAIS:Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.Participação na estruturação de processos. Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure. description: About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.- Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.- Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.- Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.- Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.- Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.Requirements- Experience: Minimum Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.- Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.- Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. title: Account Manager
description: Key Account Pleno/Sênior Gestão Estratégica de Contas · Expansão de Receita · Relacionamento Consultivo SOBRE A POSIÇÃO: Buscamos um profissional com profunda capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamentos de alto valor, visão estratégica de longo prazo e histórico comprovado na expansão sustentável de carteiras complexas. O Key Account Pleno/Sênior será o guardião das contas mais relevantes da organização — responsável não apenas por preservar a receita existente, mas por identificar, estruturar e capturar sistematicamente novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema de cada cliente. Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como um parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos. Internamente, posiciona-se como referência técnica e comportamental para o time de contas, colaborando diretamente com as lideranças comerciais na definição de estratégias de retenção, crescimento e expansão. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES: Gestão e Expansão de Carteira Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento. Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up-sell e cross-sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão. Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação. Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, roadmaps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento. Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes — operacional, gerencial e executivo — criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente. Posicionar-se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente. Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona. Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte. Retenção e Crescimento de Receita Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão. Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor. Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente. Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn. Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades. Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas. Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas. Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização. COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS: Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica. Habilidade em análise de dados de conta — consumo, receita, engajamento, risco — para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente. Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão. Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível — QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases — com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação. Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção. Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente. PERFIL E REQUISITOS: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor. Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up-sell e cross-sell. Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências. Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi-stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal. Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira. Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial). Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial. Trabalho 100% Presencial Disponibilidade para Viajar uma vez por semana COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS: Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica — compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas. Inteligência relacional — lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência. Mentalidade de dono — assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo. Perfil analítico e orientado a dados — transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor. Proatividade estruturada — identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso. Comunicação executiva — articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico. Resiliência e estabilidade emocional — mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade. BENEFÍCIOS & EXPERIÊNCIA NA EMPRESA: Aqui, você não encontra apenas um pacote de benefícios — encontra um ambiente pensado para alta performance, longevidade profissional e desenvolvimento real. Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade. Acesso a uma sociedade de estudos clássicos voltada ao desenvolvimento de líderes com pensamento crítico, profundidade e visão de longo prazo. title: Coordenador De Planejamento E Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos. Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento. Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio. Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento. Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável. Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente. Missão do cargo: Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos. Principais Responsabilidades Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo: Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
Simulações decenários(sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
Requisitos técnicosFormação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Sólida experiência emPlanejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo: Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);
Diferenciais desejáveis Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados. Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgniteFirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The RoleWe're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do- Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.- Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.- Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.- Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.- Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.- Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.- Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements- 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.- Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.- Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.- Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.- Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications- Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.- Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.- Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.- Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role- You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.- AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.- Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.- Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? - Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
postgraduate degree orMBA will be considered a plus, - Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure), - Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME, - Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners), - Advanced English (spoken and written), - Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments, - Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities, - Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally, - Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics, - High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices, - Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions. WHAT AWAITS YOU? - Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives, - Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders, - Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities, - Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums, - Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets), - Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners, - Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation, - Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning, - Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning, - Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making, - Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil, - Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions. WHAT DO WE OFFER? - Hybrid working model, - One day off on your birthday, - Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance, - Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus, - Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices, - Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy), - Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass, - Professional and personal training and development opportunities, - Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects, - Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Operador De Usv
description: Sobre a TideWise A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais. Descrição da Vaga Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo. Responsabilidades e Atribuições 1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo) Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais. Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão. Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM. Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões. 2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação. Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões. Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção. Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões. Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações. 3. Manobras e Modos de Operação Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão. Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação. 4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e "quase acidentes"). Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura. Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos). 5. Registros e Evidências Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes. Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução). Requisitos e Qualificações Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+). Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador). Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos). Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio). Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés. Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV). Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico. Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica). Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills) Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos. Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão. Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF). Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade. Benefícios TideWise: Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios. Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos. Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores. Seguro de vida. WellHub. Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations. Position Summary: The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance. Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support. Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms. Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively. Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups. Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations. Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities. Qualification and requirements: Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules. Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting. Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting. Strong problem-solving skills Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills. Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication. Valid driver’s license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments. Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus. Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued. LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion. Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps: Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to   with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician. Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English. Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps. Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

description:
Head of Commercial Partnerships

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.
Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

$95,000-$105,000
